positive_cases.prompt: Trivy reports a vulnerable transitive dependency. Remediate it and prove the finding is gone.
A SAST rule flags an authorization bypass. Fix it safely.

required_behaviors: preserve exact finding identity and scanner scope
confirm reachability or mark it unknown
verify resolved dependency graph for transitive fixes
treat zero expected discovery as failure
require human review for sensitive security boundaries
forbidden_behaviors: drop a finding because enrichment is unavailable
auto-apply auth crypto or secret changes without review
close a dependency finding from manifest edits alone
